title: Udaipur World Music Festival
metaDescription: Udaipur World Music Festival: dates, venue and planning information for world-music listeners.

overview.about: The Udaipur World Music Festival is a free world-music event held in the lakeside Indian city of Udaipur, the 'City of Lakes'. Spread across scenic venues, it brings global artists together with Indian musicians for a weekend that blends heritage settings with contemporary sound.
overview.nextEvent: The next Udaipur World Music Festival is held in February across several of the city's landmark venues. Free to attend, it features international and Indian artists across dawn, day and night stages.
